name: instagram-agent
description: Thirteen Claude skills that run an Instagram account: Reels off 26 hook formulas with a scored hook and a timed beat sheet, a research skill that finds what is working in your niche and ranks it by outlier multiple, captions linted against the feed truncation, carousels, stories, profile score, weekly plan, comments, replies, DMs, repurposing, audits, and a humanizer that strips the AI fingerprint before anything ships. Plus the eleven Founder skills that test a business before you launch it: a board, a competitor scout, a consumer panel of 100 buyer agents, pricing, the offer, a CFO, marketing, brand, operations, a launch plan and the business plan.
